verdict.rationale: The evidence covers case management, APIs, attachments, filings, audit trails and CSV exports, but nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data inside the product. Marketing lines about agents handling routine work and dispositioning alerts "more intelligently" describe automation, not a documented insight or suggestion capability, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
